proof_review.poverty: Weighted normalization, zero-share group convention, complete decomposition, strict line equality and transfer sensitivity; sharp missing-outcome bounds distinguish identification from sampling. Sharp finite-person headcount endpoints are distinguished from possibly discrete interior attainable values; population mixtures and continuous gap-index interpolation are separately stated. The respondent mean is explicitly the powered gap score for the selected alpha, with positive response share.
proof_review.credit: Concave active choice compared against inactivity globally; setup feasibility, threshold roots and unprofitable/tie boundary; wealth and lender opportunity cost included. No dynamic trap claim.
proof_review.health_education: Four feasible bundle enumeration complete including liquidity corners and ties; earnings explicitly newly produced resources, neighbor benefit separate, treasury financing explicit.
proof_review.transformation: Competitive common wage and positive demand pin price; strict concavity proves household choice and positive sector shares clear all markets. A<=subsistence explicitly outside maintained interior domain. Constant-price decomposition convention identified.
proof_review.experiment: Supported exposure mapping, positive probabilities, partial interference and exact inverse probability proof; unsupported zero-saturation treatment contrast excluded; attrition endpoints and transport limits complete. Outcome support and reported effect intervals explicitly closed, including attained endpoints.

instruction_review: Self-contained definitions before use; five worked cases; ten exact full solutions; teach-back and delayed changed-primitive retention with answer guide. Reader prerequisite points directly to C03 without production-state wording. Accepted C01 resource-budget conventions reread and retained.
source_review: Two bounded official PDF body readings and one explicitly abstract-only official NBER citation. Failed NBER body retrieval recorded. No claim of full-body, rendered, byte-retained or empirical replication validation beyond actual inspection. All numerical populations, allocations and case proofs original.
numerical_review: Standard-library independent computations cover each input/result marker, subgroup accounting, allocation witnesses, project choices/budgets/thresholds, discrete complementarity, equilibrium and exact growth decompositions, exposure enumeration and missingness bounds. Explicit malformed-domain rejections; tests supplement full proof reading.
